steps.headline: Read and draft while recent messages sync.
steps.changed: The conversation opens first. Syncing status sits above the input instead of in a separate prompt.
steps.notice: Saved messages remain visible. You can draft, but sending waits.
steps.risk: UI prototype only; this does not transfer a conversation between computers.

steps.headline: Retry, or continue with the messages you can see.
steps.changed: The same strip explains that newer messages may be on the other computer.
steps.notice: Try again checks for newer messages. Continue with these messages uses the visible history.
steps.risk: UI prototype only. Actual continuation will still require backend ownership checks.
